description: Who said basic women's t-shirts should be boring? Our women's summer V-neck short sleeve top proves the opposite: loose, lightweight and so comfortable you'll almost forget to wear it – in a good way, of course! This women's summer t-shirt is perfect for those who love oversized style without looking like a tent. The V-neck adds a feminine touch while the short sleeves with dropped shoulders highlight your arms and accompany all your movements, from fast coffee in the office to a leisurely walk in the park.This women's top is a true chameleon: combine it with jeans for a casual look, with shorts for hot summer days or simply over leggings for a relaxing evening on the couch. Whether in everyday life, leisure or in the office, this women's top always looks good – even after the third coffee of the day. Loose, light and ready for all your adventures: this oversized women's t-shirt will become your favourite summer ally. The loose fit allows you to move freely – no one likes a t-shirt that tightens or pulls out! And the best: this women's short-sleeved summer t-shirt is easy to care for and durable enough to remain comfortable and comfortable to wear even after many washes. Your basic women's top - practical, stylish and ready to live with you every summer.
feature_bullets: ANTI-COMPLEX OVERSIZED FIT This women's t-shirt features an ultra-wide fit and dropped shoulders to avoid accentuating your curves. Its intelligent design conceals the curves of the belly and offers full freedom of movement without sticking to the skin.

BASIC AND CHIC STYLE A must-have t-shirt that adapts to your pace. Wear it for a casual look at home or pair it with jeans for an outing with friends. Its minimalist design with a side slit makes it a modern and versatile staple.
UNIQUE DESIGN DETAILS Designed with a classic crew neck and hip-covering length. Dropped shoulders accentuate the casual style while the stretch fabric provides long-lasting comfort all day long.

Breathable Fabric and Styling Tip: The polyester and cotton blend ensures a cool feel ideal for summer. Note: For our light colors, we suggest wearing nude or light-colored underwear for an optimal result and complete discretion.

EASY DAILY CARE Machine washable in cold water and dry at low temperature to preserve the original shape. This basic garment retains its softness wash after wash. Please refer to our size chart before purchasing.
